conventions.convention: D is a nonempty bounded connected Lipschitz polygonal/polyhedral domain in dimension 2 or 3. Velocity has zero boundary trace, pressure has zero spatial mean, and the MINI mesh is conforming, shape-regular and affine simplicial.

The viscosity form is 2ν∫ε(v):ε(w), the pressure pairing is b(v,q)=−∫q div(v), and convection uses the real skew form. The discrete divergence constraint defines the weak kernel Z_h rather than requiring pointwise divergence-free discrete velocity.

Time nodes run from 0 to N, forcing is averaged over each cell, initialization is the L2 projection onto Z_h, and any actual mixed backward Euler root is admissible. Velocity observations sample right endpoints; reconstructed pressure equals p_h^n on (t_{n−1},t_n].
The smooth branch assumes u∈W^{1,∞}(0,T;H²∩V_σ) and p∈W^{1,∞}(0,T;H¹∩Q), using continuous representatives at time nodes. Countable Choice is assumed.

The estimates require τ_maxΛ≤1/2, retain the suppliers' explicit viscosity-dependent constants, and impose no additional mesh/time coupling. Pressure bounds concern primitives and smooth time tests, not instantaneous pressure error.

The weak-limit branch assumes the Axiom of Choice as well as Countable Choice and concludes subsequential solenoidal velocity convergence and an energy inequality without asserting pressure regularity.

The example uses D=(0,1)², T=1, three time cells, ξ(x,y)=x−1/2, and a nonconstant compactly supported smooth time test normalized by its derivative's L1 norm. Diagram spacing and node heights are schematic.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice, defines the smooth no-slip exact velocity-pressure pair and mixed backward Euler MINI solution on a bounded connected Lipschitz polygonal/polyhedral domain in dimension 2 or 3, with positive viscosity and final time, shape-regular affine simplicial mesh, cell-average L2 forcing, mass-projected initialization, endpoint velocity observations, pressure primitives, and smooth time-tested pressure observations. It asserts no error rate or solver-existence result.

Assume Countable Choice, the complete smooth MINI interface hypotheses, mass-projected initialization, any actual mixed backward Euler solution, and τ_maxΛ≤1/2. With H=hM+τ_maxM² and K exactly as displayed in the Statement, every ξ∈Q, η∈C_c^∞(0,T), and node 0≤m≤N satisfy |(P(t_m)−P_h^m,ξ)|≤KH‖ξ‖_Q and |(∫(p−p̄_h)η,ξ)|≤(K+1)H‖η′‖_L1‖ξ‖_Q. No instantaneous pressure-error rate is asserted.

Assume Countable Choice, the complete smooth MINI interface hypotheses, mass-projected initialization, any actual mixed backward Euler solution, and τ_maxΛ≤1/2. With H=hM+τ_maxM² and C_* exactly the displayed smooth velocity supplier constant, any bounded real-linear sensors ℓ_n∈V* satisfy |O_h(ℓ;u_h)−O(ℓ;u)|≤ν^(−1/2)C_*H‖ℓ‖_{ℓ²_τ(V*)}. No Reynolds-uniform claim is made.

Stronger choice assumption explicitly carried into the weak-limit scope remark.
V=H¹_0 with gradient norm, Q=L²_0 with L2 norm, strain tensor, viscosity form, and pressure-pairing sign.
Real skew convection, cancellation, and agreement with advective convection for solenoidal first argument.
Exact bubble normalization and conforming MINI velocity and mean-zero pressure spaces.
Weak divergence kernel Z_h and its distinction from exact discrete solenoidality.
Evolutionary space conventions, H_σ, forcing class, and distinction between pressure-bearing and solenoidal formulations.
Cell-average forcing, mixed recurrence, zero-mean pressure gauge, and admissibility of actual roots without a solver claim.
Nodal L2 and weighted time-integrated V error with the exact regularity, initialization, time-step restriction, and explicit C_* used by the velocity observation proposition.
Exact K, nodal primitive bound KH, continuous primitive bound (K+1)H, and smooth time-test bound used by the pressure observation proposition.
Solenoidal weak momentum equation, weak continuity, initial trace, energy inequality, and absence of an asserted pressure-regularity conclusion.
Weak-limit remark's strong L²_tL²_x and weak L²_tH¹_0 convergence, solenoidal momentum, initial trace, and energy inequality under uncoupled vanishing mesh/time steps and the Axiom of Choice.

seams_checked.note: Checked the declared page requirement and the actual uses in pthm-fd-no-slip-cfd-observations against the interface and both observation propositions. The consumer preserves strong-solution regularity, zero-mean pressure, cell-average forcing, projected initialization, actual-root scope, τ_maxΛ≤1/2, and the exact constants. Its physical interpretation explicitly adopts a weak extension, retains dimensionless numerical hypotheses, converts the pressure volume-time functional by ρ₀U₀ℓ₀⁴, and makes no instantaneous-pressure or empirical-validation claim.
